annotations.text:
Direction comes from BUILD_PLAN §5.1: warm neutral base, one saturated accent, deliberately not the Tailwind blue-and-gray that reads as template.

accent / herb / warn share lightness 0.565 and chroma 0.168 and differ only in hue, so semantic colour is carried by hue rather than by one of them shouting.

The contrast audit found a real defect. Matched oklch lightness makes the trio perceptually even — but WCAG luminance is NOT perceptual lightness, and herb and warn measured 4.0:1 and 4.4:1 on ground, under the 4.5 small text needs.

The matched trio stays for fills and icons (3:1). herb-text and warn-text carry text.

Cook mode is the constraint that shaped the type scale: legible at arm's length, on a counter, with wet hands.

28px step text, 18px floor everywhere, 44px minimum targets, inverted for glare. Designed first; the browsing screens scale down from it rather than the reverse.

The serving stepper actually runs the Phase 3 engine — try it. Salt and spices grow by factor^0.7176, potatoes round to whole units and say so, and 'to taste' never becomes a number.

Advisories appear inline, never in a modal.

Every error here is a real outcome the pipeline returns, with its actual code. 'No written recipe' is the Hebbars Kitchen case from ADR 0001 — roughly one video in five, and the one place the product must refuse rather than invent.

Desktop is the adaptation, not the origin — 390px was designed first, as BUILD_PLAN §5.4 asks.

So the rule here is: only restructure where the extra width changes what a person can DO. Recipe becomes two columns because the ingredient rail can stay put while the method scrolls, which is the whole reason to want a big screen while cooking. Feed and Creator become grids because scanning many is the task.

Extracting and Saved deliberately stay a single centred column: wider would only mean longer lines to read.

Cook mode drops the app chrome at every width — no nav, no search. It is the one screen where the phone is propped up and everything else is in the way.

On desktop it gains a second column so ingredients and the timer sit beside the step instead of below it, and the step text goes to 42px: further from the eye than a phone on a counter.
